label: Shopify product fields
description: Extends shop/product with Shopify sync metadata (readonly). Core catalogue fields stay editable for CMS-only products.

item.name: shopify_updated_at
item.label: Shopify updated
item.help: Unix time of product.updated_at from Shopify; used by Sync to skip unchanged products

item.name: shopify_checked_at
item.label: Shopify checked
item.help: Unix time of last successful Shopify Admin product fetch for this CMS product

item.name: original_artwork_src_hash
item.label: Original artwork URL hash
item.help: md5 of Shopify original_artwork file path; used to re-scrape when meta image changes
